origin.note: The walk found the owner-open defect live; the owner opening their own link is the trap this case keeps.

title: A "Not opened yet" filter on the library
objective: Add a "Not opened yet" filter to the library: libraryPage(store, userId, { notOpened: true }) and GET /api/documents?notOpened=1 show only documents that have been sent (at least one share link) and never opened by anyone but the document's owner. The owner's own opens never count, through a link or not. A chip (data-testid="filter-not-opened") on the library page reads "Not opened yet (N)" with the count. When the filter is on and nothing matches, the page reads "Every document you sent has been opened" (data-testid="empty").
acceptance: Only sent documents nobody but the owner opened are shown (d4 here)
The owner opening their own link does not take a document out of the filter
A friendly empty state when nothing matches
plan_summary: A notOpened predicate in store.mjs shared by the page and the API.
